THE WEDDING VENUE

A place to come together.

We’ll be celebrating our wedding at Eden Chalets on Friday, 11 December 2026. Gather at Adam’s Eden Chapel for the ceremony, then join us for cocktail hour and the reception.

You’ll find the venue at Kapp’s Farm on the B6, between Windhoek and Hosea Kutako International Airport.

Plan your journeyGather at the chapel at 14:30 for the 14:45 ceremony. Cocktail hour begins at 16:30, with the reception from 18:00.

Will you join us?

It would mean the world to have you beside us. Let us know using your personal invitation.

Kindly reply ↗

For our guests

Before
the big day.

We’ll keep this page updated as the day gets closer.

How do we RSVP?

Use your personal invitation link or enter your invitation code on our RSVP page. You can respond for everyone included in your invitation and share any dietary requirements.

What time should we arrive?

The groom and guests gather at Adam’s Eden Chapel at 14:30. Holy matrimony begins at 14:45, followed by confetti and photographs at 16:00. Cocktail hour at Eden Chalets and the wedding party shoot both begin at 16:30. The wedding party joins guests at 17:45, with the reception from 18:00 onwards. View the full programme

What is the dress code?

Formal attire: gentlemen may wear a suit or semi-formal attire in black or our celebration colours. Ladies may wear a floor-length gown or a midi—or knee-length cocktail dress in burgundy, burnt orange, cream, brown or sage. See the palette and outfit inspiration

Where can we stay?

Accommodation information will be shared here. Please wait for the confirmed details before making arrangements based on this invitation.

Are children and plus-ones invited?

Guest arrangements will be confirmed with your personal invitation. More information will follow.
